name: OpenClaw Home Assistant
description: Home Assistant STT, agent conversation and streaming-first TTS through OpenClaw

agentId.label: Home Assistant agent
agentId.help: Required: an existing agent ID. Never defaults silently to another agent.

persistentSession.label: Persistent session
persistentSession.help: Optional existing same-agent session key. Omit to create and durably bind one on first persistent use.

conversation.model.label: Conversation model
conversation.model.help: Native OpenClaw model reference or inherit.

conversation.thinking.label: Thinking level
conversation.thinking.help: Native OpenClaw thinking level or inherit.

conversation.fast.label: Fast mode
conversation.fast.help: Native preference: true, false, auto, ultrafast or inherit.

stt.label: Speech recognition
stt.help: Inherit the OC audio pipeline or select a native provider/model. No credentials here.

tts.label: Speech synthesis
tts.help: Inherit native OC speech settings or select provider/model/voice. No credentials here.
